ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large, contiguous high-intensity (white) region covering approximately 75% of its surface, bounded by low-intensity distal and proximal margins. Right lobe exhibits a dominant low-intensity (dark) region extending from the notch, with high-intensity mottling and discrete light blobs clustered towards the lateral tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) distributed along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the leading edges, sweeping upwards and outwards from the peduncle to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of high-contrast, roughly circular light-intensity spots located in the lower-medial dark region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of 3-5 parallel, high-intensity diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the medial-inferior quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct linear rake marks on the right lobe; focal dark-intensity spotting on the high-intensity background of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry between the left (primarily white) and right (primarily dark/mottled) lobes.
